# GameHub Ad SDK

Web-game advertising SDK for **banner**, **interstitial**, and **rewarded** ads.

## Install

```bash
npm install @gamehubsdk/gamehub-ad-sdk
```

## Quick start

```ts
import GameHubSDK from "@gamehubsdk/gamehub-ad-sdk";

await GameHubSDK.init({
  gameId: "YOUR_GAME_ID",
  apiBaseUrl: "https://api.your-domain.com",
  apiKey: "YOUR_PUBLIC_GAME_KEY"
});

await GameHubSDK.showBanner({
  containerId: "gamehub-banner-ad"
});
```

Add a banner container if you do not want automatic creation:

```html
<div id="gamehub-banner-ad"></div>
```

## Interstitial

```ts
await GameHubSDK.showInterstitial({ placementId: "level_complete" });
```

## Rewarded

```ts
await GameHubSDK.showRewardedAd({
  placementId: "extra_life",
  onReward: (reward) => {
    console.log("Reward granted", reward);
  }
});
```

## Events

```ts
GameHubSDK.on("ad_error", (event) => console.log(event.message));
GameHubSDK.on("ad_shown", (event) => console.log(event.type));
GameHubSDK.on("reward_earned", (event) => console.log(event.data));
```

## Test mode

For local SDK testing without an ad server:

```ts
await GameHubSDK.init({
  gameId: "test-game",
  testMode: true
});
```

Test mode renders a visible GameHub test creative. Real campaigns require your GameHub ad API.

## Ad API contract

By default the SDK POSTs to:

```text
POST {apiBaseUrl}/v1/sdk/ads/next
```

Request:

```json
{
  "gameId": "game_123",
  "developerId": "developer_456",
  "type": "banner",
  "placementId": "home",
  "pageUrl": "https://game.example/play"
}
```

Response:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "ad": {
    "id": "ad_123",
    "type": "banner",
    "title": "Campaign title",
    "body": "Campaign description",
    "imageUrl": "https://cdn.example/ad.png",
    "clickUrl": "https://advertiser.example",
    "impressionUrl": "https://api.example/impression/ad_123",
    "clickTrackerUrl": "https://api.example/click/ad_123"
  }
}
```

You may also return `html` instead of image/title/body. HTML creatives are rendered inside a sandboxed iframe.

## Important

This package is the client SDK. Publishing it to npm does **not** create an ad network or real advertisers. For real ads, configure `apiBaseUrl`/`adEndpoint` to your GameHub backend or integrate an approved ad provider through your backend.

Never place private server secrets in browser SDK configuration.
